title: arashouse get --json
description: What `arashouse get` prints: the lease. It is the only output that ever carries the lease password, shown once.

aras.description: The server build, for example 14.0.9.36073; null until the flavor's baseline has been built.

engine.description: The import-export-libs-js engine for this server.

password.description: The lease's Aras password, for `user` (and `admin`). Shown once; absent with `--password-fd`, which writes it to that descriptor instead.

imports.description: Present with `--import`: each import that ran, in order (docs/import.md). With `--keep-on-fail` the last may have failed.

exit_code.description: aras-pkg's exit code: 0 done, 1 failed, 2 done with errors the engine reported, 64 usage.

bootstrap.description: What `get` did to the lease after taking it; present only when it was asked to (`--code`, `--git`, `--bootstrap`).

recipe.description: With `--bootstrap`: the recipe file's absolute path (docs/bootstrap.md).

steps.description: With `--bootstrap`: the five steps in the order they run (restore, code, import, git, health), each once.

status.description: skipped: not in the recipe, or not reached because a step before it failed (the detail says which).

ok.description: True only when the step ran and passed.

log.description: The step's log: for import, the last aras-pkg log; for the others, $ARASHOUSE_HOME/logs/<lease_id>-bootstrap.log. Null for a skipped step.

code.description: One entry per `--code`, in order, as docs/schemas/deploy-code.schema.json describes them. Deploys stop at the first that fails; get then exits 10 with the lease still held, and no import runs.

git.description: The git baseline (`--git`), made last, as docs/schemas/git-baseline.schema.json describes it. A failed one exits 10 with the lease still held.
